meta.title: Sylius Starter · an open source Sylius store, ready in one command
meta.description: Sylius Starter sets up a complete Sylius project in one command. Open source code, host it anywhere, no commission on sales, and partner agencies to deliver your store.

announce.textHtml:
Friends of Sylius is reviving the momentum around Sylius.
Contributors, agencies and partners, you are all invited to take part.

hero.title: Your Sylius store, live in a few days.
hero.leadHtml: Sylius Starter sets up a complete Sylius project in one command. A partner agency builds on it to deliver your store at a fixed price. The code is open source, you host it wherever you like and no commission is taken on your sales.

own.title: Differences between SaaS and Sylius
own.intro: On a SaaS platform you pay a subscription, often a commission on sales, and your data stays with the vendor. With Sylius, the code, the theme and the data live with you.
rentItems: The subscription goes up with your revenue
Transaction fees and monthly paid apps
Data export limited to what the platform allows
The product roadmap is the vendor's call
ownItems: A fixed price and timeline agreed before work starts
The code, the theme and the database are yours
Switch agency, host or module whenever you want
Features built specifically for your core business
own.migrate: Already running a store? We'll help you migrate

sovereignty.title: Your data, hosted with full sovereignty
sovereignty.intro: With Sylius Starter, you choose where your store and your customers' data live. Not a platform vendor.

options.title: Host the store yourself
options.p: In-house servers or an existing cloud: the store and its data sit alongside the rest of your information system, in the same place.

options.title: Your agency advises you
options.p: The agency building your store recommends the hosting that fits your traffic, your budget and your constraints.

promiseItems: Your data stays yours, with no dependency on a vendor
You can move it to another host without any hassle
You host in Europe and comply with GDPR and European regulations

paths.title: For your online store, two ways to get started
paths.specialistWho: You're an e-commerce business or project manager
paths.specialistTitle: Hand the project to an agency
specialistItems: A Sylius agency scopes the project with you and commits to a price.
A custom store is delivered in a few days.
Migration, maintenance and training are available depending on the project.
paths.devWho: You're a developer, with or without AI assistance
devItems: Clone the repository and run castor sylius:init.
Catalog import, plugins and deployment are already built in.
The documentation is written for humans and AI agents alike.

found.title: What Sylius Starter does
found.leadHtml: Sylius Starter is a set of Castor commands (wait, what is Castor?) around a standard Sylius project. You bootstrap a project, then add or remove features as your needs evolve.

feats.html: sylius:init creates the project: Docker, Sylius, database, assets, fixtures and tests.
sylius:add installs, configures and migrates a plugin. sylius:remove takes it out again, configuration and migrations included.
sylius:theme:setup switches the whole storefront theme, removing the previous one first.
sylius:b2b:enable turns on B2B features, such as hiding prices.
sylius:menu:remove hides the back-office entries you don't need.

ecosystem.title: Built on Sylius and Symfony
ecosystem.intro: Sylius is an open source e-commerce platform built on Symfony. Sylius Starter adds no proprietary layer: your project stays a standard Sylius project that any Symfony team can pick up.

benefits.title: Agencies and freelancers
benefits.p: Several agencies and independent developers already work with Sylius. No need to build it yourself: you choose who to work with.

benefits.title: No dependency on one vendor
benefits.p: The code follows Symfony conventions. Another team can take over without rewriting everything.

benefits.title: Hosted where you want
benefits.p: A dedicated server, a European cloud or your own infrastructure: Sylius Starter doesn't impose anything.

event.title: Meet us at PS Summit
event.p: The first open source event shared by PrestaShop and Sylius: workshops, technical talks and case studies. Come and talk to us about your project.

offer.title: Working with a partner agency
offer.intro: Services are delivered by independent Sylius agencies. You deal with them directly.

plans.name: Custom store
plans.desc: The agency assembles your store from the Starter's modules: theme, checkout, payment, shipping, search. Scope and price are set upfront, and the store is live in a few days.

plans.name: Migration
plans.desc: Audit of your current setup, data transfer and cutover from your existing platform. Pricing depends on volume and integrations.

plans.name: Maintenance and training
plans.desc: Corrective and evolutive maintenance, plus training so your team gets the most out of your store.
